name: Golkor Inc.
summary: Golkor Inc. currently has no substantial business operations. Its primary objective is to complete a strategic business combination, which may take various forms such as a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, or corporate reorganization with one or more other entities. Established in 1992, the company was formerly known as KAT Exploration Inc. until it adopted the name Golkor Inc. in May 2025. Its headquarters are located in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida.
